_doc: One-line rationale per <app>|<rule_id> group for the human TP/FP pass recorded in labels.json. Written during the 2026-08-04 pass that cleared the last 127 UNLABELED findings (issue #18). No script reads this file; it exists so a label can be audited without re-deriving the evidence.
achnbrowserui|ats-arbitrary-loads: TP — NSAllowsArbitraryLoads=true confirmed in the flagged Info.plist. Browsers have a defensible justification, but the 1.6 data-security question at review is real, which is what the WARN says.
achnbrowserui|custom-review-prompt: FP — AboutView.swift links to the App Store review page from a static About row; that is not a custom in-app review prompt replacing SKStoreReviewController.
achnbrowserui|privacy-manifest-parity: TP — no PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy anywhere in the repo (verified with find) while the app uses Required Reason APIs. Required since May 2024.
achnbrowserui|subscription-links-restore: FP — the finding is the configuration notice 'no paywall view found, set .paywallGlobs', not a missing link. Matches the 7 earlier FP labels for this rule.
achnbrowserui|xcode-sdk-requirement: FP — LastUpgradeCheck records the Xcode version that last ran the project upgrade check, not the SDK the app is built against. Panel apps build in CI with current Xcode while this field stays behind, so the signal cannot support the claim.
asspp|autorenew-disclosure: FP — the purchase path is ApplePackage.Purchase for App Store items, not an auto-renewable subscription, so no renewal disclosure is required.
